name: shader_ce694a
vertexShader: varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.); }
fragmentShader: uniform vec3 uCol; varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ float d = length(vUv - .5) * 2.; gl_FragColor = vec4(uCol * pow(max(0., 1. - d), 2.2) * .16, 1.); }
